title: Badge popover
summary: A status pill that is a button: it opens a panel of details (heading, body, optional actions) anchored under it, and on a phone the panel spans the viewport inside the gutters. Escape, an outside press or focus leaving closes it.

props.name: heading
props.description: Panel title; it also names the panel for assistive technology.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the panel when there is no heading (falls back to the pill text).

props.name: placement
props.description: Preferred side of the panel on a wide screen.

slots.description: The pill text (for example a count and a noun: "5 failing").

slots.name: actions
slots.description: Buttons at the foot of the panel; hidden when empty. A slotted element with data-close closes the panel.

events.name: pk-close
events.description: The panel is closing (escape, outside, blur, toggle, action); cancelable.

cssProperties.name: --pk-badge-popover-w
cssProperties.description: Panel width on a wide screen.

a11y: The pill is one native button (its own focus ring) with aria-expanded, aria-haspopup="dialog" and aria-controls the panel; the panel is a dialog named by its heading or label. Enter and Space toggle it; opened by keyboard, focus moves into the panel; Escape closes it and returns focus to the pill; an outside press or focus leaving closes it without moving focus. The pill text is the button's name, so put the meaning in words ("5 failing checks"), not only a colour or an icon.
